objective: Protect the validated 10-Core / one-shared-capital primary engine and add a secondary small-signal Satellite layer that trades only during Core quiet periods. The five primary Satellite markets are SUIUSDC, NEARUSDC, UNIUSDC, AAVEUSDC and BCHUSDC; additional markets are optional only if useful. Any executable Core entry has absolute priority and preempts an active Satellite at the next executable open.
priorities: Do not rerun the rejected Run #78/#79 micro family unchanged; #79 was byte-identical duplicate evidence and counts as zero research progress.
Use canonical_core_baseline as the protected numerical reference; do not substitute stale 3x80, isolated 10x250 or remembered '~1500 profit' figures.
Preserve the validated ten-Core product unchanged as the primary earnings engine.
Develop dedicated short-duration small-signal Satellite fillers for SUI/NEAR/UNI/AAVE/BCH first; optional additional USDC markets may supplement the pool but never replace the Core mission.
Satellites trade only while the Core engine is completely idle and are secondary to every executable Core entry signal.
When a Core entry becomes executable, close the active Satellite at that same executable open before allocating the Core trade.
Select Satellite family/parameters/horizon on training only. Direct-USDC holdout, shifted, future and red-team evidence may reject but never select or retune.
Optimize after-cost incremental shared-account profit and reduction of long idle gaps; activity without profit is failure.
Prepare a 50-USDC real trial only after engineering validation; normal initial configured production capital is 250 USDC. 1000 USDC scale is a later validation target.
research_fronts: clean unchanged V1 baseline on SUI/NEAR/UNI/AAVE/BCH
bounded per-market V1 evolution without Core-V6 template inheritance
short-horizon exits and handoff only after the five Satellite entry/exit strategies themselves are suitable
success_rule: Mission success requires a secondary Satellite layer that, on like-for-like one-shared-C tests, preserves or exceeds the canonical protected f649 Core baseline after costs/stress while materially reducing long Core-idle gaps. The ten-Core engine remains primary and unchanged; Satellites may open only while Core is completely idle and must yield to any executable Core entry at the next executable open.

profit_concession.note: For the final satellite/router architecture, higher activity is not allowed to buy lower robust shared-account profit. Research diagnostics may explore trade-offs, but promotion requires non-regressive baseline and stress performance.

recent_evidence.detail: 2/4/6h exact-full-Core-idle horizon family; UNI training winner 6h but direct-USDC rejected; SUI/NEAR/AAVE/BCH had no fully robust training horizon.
recent_evidence.next: Test bounded point-in-time entry filters on unchanged V1 flip-up signals using CMO strength, normalized breakout strength and positive 24h VIDYA slope. Training selects filter+exit; Direct-USDC holdout rejects only. Require positive baseline and stress with at least 20 training cycles before Core-idle replay.
recent_evidence.run_74_detail: Nine replacement markets completed the old V1-style 4/8/12h free-capacity baseline after ZECUSDC data-quality exclusion; none had a training-robust positive edge.
recent_evidence.run_82_best_simple_pattern: NEARUSDC 4h +1.00/-1.00: 217 UP_FIRST vs 184 DOWN_FIRST, 54.1147% decisive win rate; direction edge exists but symmetric after-cost expectation remains negative.

run_84_summary.interpretation: Exit-only repair is insufficient; poor entry selectivity dominates. Move to point-in-time filtered-entry research.
